reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend helper with a holidays parameter and threads it through getNextDate and app.ts, though app.ts's daily branch re-checks holidays inline instead of using the new predicate.

duplication.why: The weekend-or-holiday predicate is defined privately as isNonBusinessDay in shared/schedules.ts and then re-written inline in app.ts's daily branch.

placement.why: The rule lives in the shared schedules module where weekend handling already lives, but the predicate is not exported, so the server layer reimplements it.

scope.why: Only the schedule date logic, the RecurConfig type and focused tests are touched.

maintainability.why: The direction-based loop generalises the helper cleanly, but the budget schedule-template callers do not pass holidays and the daily rule is duplicated, so holiday behaviour diverges between paths.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange daily branch inlines `d.isWeekend(date) || config.holidays?.includes(...)` instead of the shared isNonBusinessDay predicate

disguised_duplication.where: The inline daily check in app.ts is an openly repeated copy of isNonBusinessDay, not a reshaped one.

one_place.where: Holiday handling is added to getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but the two callers in server/budget/schedule-template.ts are not given holidays, and the daily-skip rule is written separately in shared/schedules.ts (isNonBusinessDay) and server/schedules/app.ts (inline).
